slides.desc: Voice-first macOS agent. A fast local System 1 acts; an LLM System 2 is asked only when unsure. Every step gated and logged.
Four cats vs. one RL mouse in 3D mazes. A solver-distilled policy plays in your browser via ONNX.
The game from those fake mobile ads, for real: pick multiplier gates and outgun mobs, walls and bosses across 5 zones.
A better Storage screen for programmers: one scan of what your dev machine has piled up, reclaimed through each tool's own command.
Finds git worktrees left behind by AI coding agents, shows the evidence, and cleans up without breaking the agent's own lifecycle.
What just happened on my Mac? A classified timeline from the unified log, crash reports and persistence items. No root, no daemon.
Follow the trail through a codebase in Neovim: a call bow-tie on K, trace mode with notes, and what your agent changed. No AI, no index.
